name: What is considered a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home renovation typically involves updating or reconfiguring most or all major areas of the house—layout, finishes, systems, and sometimes structure—rather than focusing on a single room or small area.
